title: Single-aspect primary living space depth at most 3 x ceiling height (R30-R60)
text: The maximum depth¹ of a single aspect primary living space shall be a maximum three times (3x) the ceiling height (refer Figure 2.1b). ¹Exclusive of built-in cabinetry along walls. Note: Additional livings spaces (such as a second lounge room) are not subject to the provisions of C2.1.1 – C2.1.3
notes: new: no Chapter 3 equivalent. Depth exclusive of built-in cabinetry along walls (footnote 1); the fact is the largest depth / ceiling height ratio of any single-aspect primary living space. Additional living spaces (a second lounge) are not subject to C2.1.1 to C2.1.3 (Note). R30-R60 per the heading, which covers C2.1.1 to C2.1.3 (p15).
